verdict.rationale: Extend documents Workflows, Async Processing, and Webhook Configuration, which together let users set up document-processing pipelines that run in the background without manual intervention, and highlights 'Agentic OCR' and 'Composer & Review Agent' as autonomous processing features. However, there is no explicit documentation of scheduling, triggers, or continuous background monitoring beyond webhook callbacks for async jobs, and no independent/hands-on evidence of a running autonomous automation. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on scheduling/triggers for recurring automations, independent confirmation of autonomous background runs, and clarity on how workflows persist without user-initiated calls.
